title: Classify marks by role and provenance before cleanup
when: A source contains pencil marks mixed with printed geometry.
do: Inventory every segment, arc, arrow, tick, fill and label.
Use topology, repeated print style, stroke continuity and source context as evidence; grayscale alone is insufficient.
Retain ambiguous marks in the ledger; exclude confirmed student marks only from the restored layer.
check: Printed AP/angle marks retained; student B/C additions excluded; original crop unchanged.
limitation: The feedback is direct evidence for these Daechi cases; a general automatic classifier is not qualified.
